title: Hespori (Echo)
wikitext:
{{HasStrategy}} {{Infobox Monster |name = Hespori (Echo) |image = [[File:Hespori (Echo).png|150px]] |release = [[27 November]] [[2024]] |update = Leagues V: Raging Echoes OUT NOW! |members = Yes |combat = 426 |size = |examine = A big angry plant. |xpbonus = |max hit = 52 ([[Magic]]) |aggressive = Yes |poisonous = Yes (4) |attack style = [[Ranged]], [[Magic]] |attack speed = 6 |hitpoints = 900 |att = 1 |str = 1 |def = 120 |mage = 250 |range = 200 |attbns = 0 |strbns = 0 |amagic = 150 |mbns = 0 |arange = 150 |rngbns = 0 |dstab = 60 |dslash = 20 |dcrush = 60 |dmagic = 80 |dlight = 80 |dstandard = 80 |dheavy = 80 |elementalweaknesstype = Fire |elementalweaknesspercent = 100 |poisonresistance = 100 |venomresistance = 100 |immunecannon = Yes |freezeresistance = 100 |id = override8583 |leagueRegion = Kourend }} '''Hespori (Echo)''' is a more challenging variant of [[Hespori]] that is accessible during the [[Demonic Pacts League]]. To fight it the player must have a [[Kourend echo orb]] in their inventory, which is dropped by regular Hespori. Challenging the Echo Hespori does not require a [[hespori seed]], nor does it consume the orb. However, unlike the regular version, Hespori (Echo) '''does not''' grant Farming experience when harvested after killing it. Despite not granting Farming experience, [[Tangleroot]] can still be dropped by Hespori (Echo). During the fight, the plants that grow will be using either [[Protect from Melee]] or a combination of [[Protect from Magic]] and [[Protect from Missiles]], thus requiring two combat styles for the encounter. The unique drop of Hespori (Echo) is [[Nature's recurve]], a bow that can restore health and prayer points. Choosing to fight the Hespori (Echo) upon entering the cave will reset the patch, discarding the seed if one has been planted. If the player forgets to bring a [[spade]] for clearing Hespori (Echo) to receive the drops, it can be returned to by choosing '''not''' to fight the Echo version. ==Drops== {{Main|Hespori#Drops}} Hespori (Echo) rolls the same drops as regular Hespori, in addition to a roll for its unique echo item. {{DropsTableHead}} {{DropsLine|name=Nature's recurve|quantity=1|rarity=1/15|gemw=No|raritynotes={{refn|group=d|In addition to having a 1/15 chance to drop, players will '''always''' receive the nature's recurve on their 30th Hespori (Echo) kill if they haven't received one yet.}}}} {{DropsTableBottom}} ===Tertiary=== {{DropsTableHead}} {{DropsLine|name=Tangleroot|quantity=1|rarity=|gemw=No|bucket=No}} {{DropsTableBottom}} ==Past appearances== This boss has appeared in a previous [[temporary event]]: *[[Raging Echoes League]] ** The unique drop was the [[nature's reprisal]] ==Changes== ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Hespori (Echo, Raging Echoes League).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Hespori (Echo).png|center|300x150px]] |- |27 November 2024–
